summary: Haven is a self-hosted blogging platform that allows you to write posts using markdown formatting. It also includes a built-in RSS reader so you can follow other feeds from the same interface. The project is licensed under the MIT licence and built with Ruby.
goodFor: It suits individuals who want a straightforward, private space for markdown blogging combined with an integrated feed reader on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: The repository currently has no tagged releases and development activity is slowing, which may introduce stability risks or require you to rely directly on the master branch.
deployNotes: Because this application is built with Ruby, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination, provision a persistent database, and manage a Ruby runtime environment on your server.
